### Checklist

- [ ] I followed every step in qrate **<version>** myself, and the menus and labels match that version.
- [ ] `qrateVersion` in the front matter is that version.
- [ ] The search phrase is in the title, the filename, the `description`, and the first paragraph.
- [ ] The first paragraph says what the reader will have at the end.
- [ ] Every menu path and setting is in the [docs](https://qrate.dvnl.work/docs) or the app; nothing is guessed.
- [ ] It has at least two visuals (a screenshot, or a `Figure` with `AppMock`, `DialogMock` or `FolderTree`), each with a caption.
- [ ] Screenshots are in `public/guides/<filename>/`, under 300 KB each, with real alt text, and show no private collection material.
- [ ] It links two or three other guides in the body, and the matching docs pages in `related`.
- [ ] `bun run build` passes.
